_comment: Edit this file to change digest behaviour. Commit the change and the next run picks it up.
_dedup_days_comment: Links seen in a digest_type's output are skipped for this many days across runs (stored in the seen_links table).

org._days_back_comment: How many days back to look for new content. 2 gives a buffer so weekend gaps don't miss Monday's news.
org._max_items_comment: Cap on articles fetched per source per run. Prevents a single prolific org from flooding the digest.
org._min_items_comment: If fewer than this many articles are found across all sources, skip generating this digest type for the run.
